excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase One — Limitless Social Network Brainstorm The Awtsmoos is beyond follower and followed, sender and receiver, yet Awtsmoos.com may reveal a social world where every relationship is a transparent vessel: simple at first touch, deep when opened, private where it must be, alive where i
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — limitless social network brainstorm the awtsmoos is beyond follower and followed, sender and receiver, yet awtsmoos.com may reveal a social world where every relationship is a transparent vessel: simple at first touch, deep when opened, private where it must be, alive where it can be. the ideal social world one identity context feeds profile, follow graph, inbox, messages, spaces, activity, discovery, and realtime presence. every optimistic mutation has an explicit lifecycle: idle → pending → acknowledged or rolled back. feed/discovery ranking is data driven and explainable: recency, relationship affinity, destination relevance, authored content, and explicit user filters remain separate factors. follow/unfollow state updates immediately in every visible surface, then reconciles with server truth. profile surfaces distinguish self, followed, follower, mutual, stranger, and unavailable states without duplicate conditionals. posts/comments/replies expose provenance, destination, author, timestamps, media, transform lineage, privacy, and interaction affordances through one normalized presentation model. composer drafts survive route changes and recover from transient failure. media composition gets explicit upload state, cancellation, validation, progress, and retry rather than a single opaque submit. comments and replies can be promoted/transformed while original provenance remains visible. inbox becomes a converged notification stream with typed events: follow, reply, mention, message, room activity, system signal. notification unread/read state is explicit, batchable, and resumable. private messages have conversation list, unread counts, delivery state, read state, typing/presence hints where transport supports it, and bounded reconnection behavior. torah chat remains a public realtime chamber with room membership, reconnect state, message timestamps, and graceful offline manifestation. presence never pretends certainty; stale/unknown/offline/online are distinct states. realtime reconnect uses bounded exponential backoff and one visible connection status shared by all live surfaces. search spans aliases, people, spaces, destinations, posts, and conversations through one federated query contract with clear result kinds. discovery supports public/new/related/following modes without each surface owning its own unrelated pagination semantics. spaces expose membership, role, visibility, latest activity, and creator actions with progressive disclosure. mobile primary tasks stay visible; expert metadata and advanced controls retract into native details/sheets/dialogs. every route restores focus and maintains logical reading order. keyboard users can reach every social action; touch targets remain at least 44px where feasible. reduced motion keeps every state change understandable without animation. busy/error/success/empty/offline states are first class views, not text appended ad hoc. sensitive/private data never leaks into public discovery or url state. api cancellation prevents stale route responses from overwriting newer identity or route truth. cache ownership is explicit: identity scoped data is invalidated when alias changes; public discovery can outlive private state. a social operation ledger can expose pending mutations to status ui without hard coding every feature. tests cover route state, identity switching, optimistic rollback, api cancellation, realtime reconnection, follow graph normalization, message delivery state, composer draft restoration, and accessibility contracts. documentation names the real api routes and the frontend authorities that own them. five possible architectures a — keep adding feature callbacks into appassembly fastest today, worst future coupling. rejected. b — one giant socialstore and one giant socialcontroller central consistency but creates a new monolith. rejected. c — domain authorities + shared identity/session state + operation/realtime coordinators preferred. existing panels remain feature local while cross cutting identity, mutation lifecycle, and realtime truth become explicit collaborators. d — full rewrite into a framework would discard proven contracts and create migration risk. rejected. e — event bus for everything loose coupling superficially, but hidden data flow and debugging cost. rejected as primary architecture; narrowly typed dom/custom events remain acceptable where already proven. chosen revelation architecture c: strengthen the existing modular system rather than replacing it. split assembly/lifecycle first, normalize cross surface state second, then deepen feature domains behind compatibility preserving apis.
